notes.title: Language update: french translation
notes.content:
"Blackberry The Witch" has been translated into French.

Additionally, some fixes have been made to the English translation, and minor fixes have been implemented, particularly addressing a text overflow issues on the diary pages.

Regarding future updates:
Work is currently underway on cards and avatars for Steam.
Preparations are also in progress for a small Halloween event.

notes.title: Update 307-build Released for Blackberry the Witch: Journey
notes.content:
Hello!

We have released an update that includes bug fixes and gameplay improvements. Here is a list of the changes you can expect:

[list]
[*] Fixed the interaction point with the duct tape in the compass quest. Players will now be able to interact with this item easily.
[*] Made minor adjustments to the English localization.
[*] Addressed issues with the Artefactor's functionality.
[/list]
We are constantly striving to enhance the gameplay experience and closely monitor player feedback. We appreciate your support and assistance in identifying these issues. Your feedback is invaluable to us, and we are continuously working to make the game better and more enjoyable for all our players.

If you have any questions or concerns, please don't hesitate to contact us. We are always here to help.

Thank you!

Best regards,
The Development Team of "Blackberry the Witch: Journey"
